I just booked a demo via the self-serve form — booked Nov 16 10:00 AM PST (invite attached). We're evaluating Redwood Dedicated for inference serving. Hi Priyom — thanks for the quick reply.

We can fill out the intake template — attaching a short note below to start:
- Typical qps baseline: 180–300 (normal), spikes up to ~2k for ~2–5 minute windows during batch releases.
- Payload: avg 4.2 KB JSON per request (text + metadata).
- Model: mixture of 13B instruction-tuned models and a smaller reranker; plan to move to quantized variants if latency requires it.
- P95 target: <=200ms for generation up to 512 tokens (firm for customer SLA).
- Network: we prefer VPC peering; production will be in our AWS account (us-west-2).

Nov 17 10:00 AM PST works for us if that guarantees an SE. Please confirm and send updated invite.

Appreciate it — Samira

Hi Samira — thanks for the details, that helps a lot. Karthik here (Solutions Engineer). A few things we'll dive into on the call and a couple of asks if you can prep:

1) Throughput sizing: based on the numbers you gave (baseline 200–300 qps, 2k spikes), we'll likely recommend starting with a 2-node Dedicated pool (A100/80G-class exec) with autoscale headroom for spikes. Exact sizing depends on model family and batch policy.

2) Latency target: p95 <=200ms for 512 tokens is aggressive but achievable with the right kernel selection + batching constraints. If you expect synchronous single-request traffic during spikes, we'll discuss prefix caching and CPU-offloading strategies.

3) Pre-call artifacts:
   - The filled intake PDF (quantiflow-mrap-reqs.pdf) — helps us run a quick cost/latency simulation.
   - A small set of representative payloads (3–5 JSONs) — optional but helpful.

4) Network & security: If you want VPC private deployment later, we'll cover steps and when you'd need the Private product vs Dedicated.

I can join Nov 17 10:00 AM PST. If anyone on your side needs an earlier time, we can add a short technical pre-brief (30 min) the same day earlier — otherwise I'll be fully present on the 17th demo.

Attached: quick SE checklist link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xg-example-runbook

Look forward to it — Karthik
